name: RC-B10-0248/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on violations of religious freedom in Tibet
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns China's treatment of Tibetan Buddhists and asks China to stop interfering in choosing Tibetan spiritual leaders, including the Dalai Lama. It expresses sorrow over the death of Tulku Hungkar Dorje in custody in Vietnam and asks for an independent investigation and the return of his remains. It also asks the European Union to consider sanctions on Chinese officials responsible for rights violations.

- The text changes no law; it is the Parliament's opinion and set of demands.
- It concerns Tibetan Buddhists, Tulku Hungkar Dorje's family, and Chinese and Vietnamese authorities.
- Next, the resolution is sent to China, Vietnam, the United Nations rights chief and the Tibetan administration.
